title: A Novel Prognostic Model of NPI for Risk-Predicting and Clinical Decision-making in Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma in the Rituximab Era
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the predictive value of a model of Nomogram Prognostic Index (NPI) in patients with Diffuse Large B cell lymphoma.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* histologically confirmed diagnosis of CD20+ DLBCL

Exclusion Criteria:

* primary central nervous system lymphoma
* "double-hit" lymphoma
